title: RESTCONF / YANG
intro: The box exposes a RESTCONF (RFC 8040) API at /restconf, driven by YANG 1.1 modules generated from the configuration schema — one module per configuration domain. Use the same credentials as the REST API. Download the modules below for your NETCONF/RESTCONF tooling.
